sections.Profile:
The "Lethal Weapon 3" pinball machine, released by Data East in 1992, is based on the popular action film of the same name. Designed by Ed Cebula and Joe Kaminkow, this machine includes artwork by Markus Rothkranz and features animations by Jack Liddon. It boasts a full view dot matrix display that shows digitized movie clips, enhancing the game's thematic connection to the movie.
